scope: Direct Computer Use pointer/keyboard input in the ordinary Windows11 GUI; monitor2 and generated paused audio only
observations: Initial Interface category shows Current screen and an enabled selector after the real category-open refresh.
The actual popup contains Current screen and both genuine connected monitors.
Pointer selection of LF24T450F saves qt-fullscreen-screennumber=1 and displays Restart VLC to apply these changes.
Escape dismisses the dialog. F11 enters and exits fullscreen on monitor2, keeping the generated paused input and displayed zero clock.
The initial app exits normally via Ctrl+Q.
A cold isolated app copies the unchanged saved configuration. Its F11 fullscreen entry/return remains on monitor2 with paused clock zero.
The cold Interface selector restores LF24T450F without a stale restart notice.
Home/Return in the open combo selects Current screen and displays restart feedback; independent disk readback shows #qt-fullscreen-screennumber=-1, the native default form.
End/Return restores LF24T450F, restores the explicit saved value1 and clears restart feedback.
The cold app exits normally via Ctrl+Q. No permission prompt was observed in either session.
